# QVAC AI SDK Provider v0.12.1 Release Notes

📦 **NPM:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/@qvac/ai-sdk-provider/v/0.12.1

This patch moves the provider onto `@qvac/cli` 0.20. Provider behavior is unchanged.

## Dependency Alignment

The optional `@qvac/cli` peer is now `^0.20.0`. A 0.x caret range does not cross a minor, so `^0.19.0` would not accept CLI 0.20.
